transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because... it's about elevators. I mean, I know they aren't really dangerous, but whenever I have to get in one, I get scared like I'm going to be trapped in there. I just can't make myself feel normal about it, even though I know better.
Do you ever have these same intense fear or panic feelings suddenly, out of the blue, in situations that have nothing to do with elevators?
No, not really. It's just the elevators. If I'm not near one or thinking about having to use one, I feel fine. I don't just get scared out of nowhere.
